title: move privacy notice to dartlang.org
body: Move the wiki here:  https://github.com/dart-lang/dart-pad/wiki/Privacy-Policy to somewhere on dartlang.org.  Rename it to "privacy notice", and consider rewriting the section on source code retention (those are no longer retained beyond the HTTP log rotation times AFAICT).
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: The page is up on dartlang.org: https://www.dartlang.org/tools/dartpad/privacy

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
